summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Frontend engineer with 5 years of experience building scalable web applications (SPA, SSR, SSG) using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Proven expertise in technical leadership, CI/CD implementation, and deploying solutions in AWS environments. Currently focused on enhancing architectural skills and leveraging cloud technologies.

list.title: Bachelor in Information Systems and Technologies

details.project: A set of web applications and services for managing and transporting chemical substances between medical research laboratories.
achievements: Led a team of 3 frontend developers, delivering and maintaining key React and Next.js applications
Built a unified CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins and Terraform for seamless deployment of all frontend apps to AWS ECS
Initiated and led the migration of two legacy applications to a modern tech stack (React + Redux)
Proposed and scoped a new web application, which was approved by the client and moved to active development

details.project: Set of web applications for modeling relationships between database entities in medical research labs (e.g., Animal → has → Cage → has → Number) using a tree-graph editor. The system also enables entity creation and editing within connected databases.
achievements: Defined the tech stack and organized a monorepo (Yarn workspaces) with a custom UI Kit, speeding up development across apps
Developed a performant canvas-based (React-flow) tree graph editor for modeling complex relationships
Integrated Azure Active Directory for secure authentication across all applications

details.project: Web application for detecting diseases in CT and X-ray scans using a neural network.
achievements: Developed a universal system for rendering forms and tables based on JSON schemas, improving reusability and maintainability
Created a DICOM web viewer (Cornerstone.js) for comparing, annotating, and analyzing medical scans
Refactored and optimized architecture to improve component reuse and page load times

details.project: Web application for tracking chemical shipments between research labs. The goal was to rewrite a legacy Marionette + Backbone app with modern technologies and improve performance.
achievements: Actively contributed to the technology stack selection (React, Redux, Recoil) and architecture planning
Implemented full test coverage with Cypress (e2e) and RTL (unit tests)
Participated in the development cycle from planning to production release

details.project: Web app for tracking people movement within buildings.
achievements: Expanded real-time tracking functionality using WebSockets
Unified the application architecture to support different map providers (OSM, Google Maps API)
